title: Trader Reveals Most Dangerous, Crowded Trades | Jason Shapiro
speaker: Jason Shapiro (interviewed by David Lin)

macro_themes.view: Sugar, corn, soybeans and soymeal are the most crowded longs after El Nino and Ukraine war; crowding only makes a reversal potentially bigger, not more likely, and any fade may last 3-4 weeks before fundamentals resume.
Agrees a reversal in crowded grain trades could ease food inflation, but crowdedness doesn't mean it has to turn.

notes: Short clip; he names crowded trades but explicitly declines to call a reversal ('doesn't mean it's going to go down'), so no directional calls recorded.
